observation: Tuple observation [player_sum, dealer_showing_card, usable_ace] represented as a normalized numeric vector.
preprocessing: Tuple fields flattened to a three-dimensional numeric vector and normalized by the largest absolute field value.
reward: +1 for win, 0 for draw, -1 for loss under the Gymnasium Blackjack rules.
termination: Player sticks or goes bust; dealer then resolves the hand according to the built-in policy.
opponent: Built-in dealer policy: draw until reaching 17, then stick.
stochasticity: Gymnasium reset seed controls card draws and initial hands.
